PATCHSET 1 TOOK Verified -1. NOT the module-size gate (that one PASSED) and not overridable: a
real derived-artifact drift, now fixed in patchset 2 (749bc2b41, Change-Id preserved).

CAUSE: docs/env-vars.md is GENERATED from env-var reads under src/rebar by
scripts/gen_env_registry.py, and it records the LINE NUMBER of each non-literal
os.environ.get() call. Adding 7 lines to config.py shifted four recorded line numbers
(389/423/438/458 -> 396/430/445/465), so the committed doc no longer matched its generator.
Nothing about the change's behaviour was wrong; the artifact was simply not regenerated.

WORTH KNOWING FOR EVERY FUTURE CHANGE IN THIS EPIC: this gate fires on ANY line-count change in a
file containing a non-literal env read, even a pure comment edit. src/rebar/llm/config.py is such
a file. So any change touching config.py must run scripts/gen_env_registry.py and commit the
result. It is cheap to forget and costs a full CI round trip.

The failing gate sits EARLY in the pytest job, so seven later gates never ran and their status was
unknown. Rather than push and discover them one round trip at a time, I ran all of them locally
against patchset 2. ALL TEN PASS, tree clean afterwards (no derived artifact dirty):
  check_verify_gate_parity, check_docs_index --check, check_readme_quickstart, gen_cli_reference,
  gen_mcp_reference, check_server_manifest, gen_env_registry,
  rebar.llm.plan_review.registry validate-routing (42 criteria in sync),
  rebar.schemas.gen_types, and the module-size gate.

MODULE SIZE of every file this change touches, measured at 749bc2b41 against the 800 cap:
  config.py 793 (7 to spare)   sizing.py 612   production_batch_runner.py 282
  code_review/batch_runner.py 143   workflow/runners.py 188   plan-review.yaml 382
config.py at 793 is the tight one. A future change adding more than 7 lines to it must extract
something first; it has no room left.
